world_law.capacity: Aggregate signed capacity changes then clamp to [0, maximum]; all expenditures remain charged.
world_law.institutions: Unanimous named members, effective no earlier than next TURN; pact/channel only. No automated compliance.

operations.damage: Spend own resource units to reduce target capacity by amount * effect_scale.
operations.message: Public claim to target; amount=0. No truth or physical effects implied.
operations.posture: Own declared posture; target must be your actual state_id, amount=0. No automatic reaction.
operations.private_message: Claim delivered only to target and sender, via an active mutually agreed channel; amount=0.
operations.repair: Spend own resource units to restore capacity by amount * effect_scale; foreign work requires consent.
operations.transfer: Give amount of own resource units; recipient consent required.

world_law.scope: Synthetic immediate reach; no interception, transport delay or accuracy model.
world_law.settlement: Simultaneous. Oversubscribed actor resource operations all fail; incoming stock unavailable until next TURN.
world_law.unknown_effects: Preserve as unresolved; no claimed effect. Independent supported effects may settle.
